name: WARNING: Texas Roadhouse Cactus Blossom (Fried Colossal Onion)
whyItWorks: Colossal Texas onion sliced into petals, dipped in seasoned flour batter, deep-fried, and served with spicy Cajun horseradish dip. Packs 135g of oxidized fryer fat and massive onion fructans, guaranteeing severe intestinal distress and diarrhea.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Never order or graze on the Cactus Blossom. Choose a plain baked potato or plain applesauce cup instead.
